rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the act of keeping something or something kept.

example.english: This document is for retention, so don't throw it away.
example.traditional: 呢份文件要保留，唔好掉咗佢。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 man4 gin6 jiu3 bou2 lau4 m4 hou2 diu6 zo2 keoi5

rows.note: Use this specifically for someone's ability to remember things.

example.english: My retention has gotten much worse because I haven't been sleeping enough lately.
example.traditional: 我近排瞓得唔夠，記性差咗好多。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gan6 paai2 fan3 dak1 m4 gau3 gei3 sing3 caa1 zo2 hou2 do1
